## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

## Now that we loaded in our tools and library, lets summarize

## The summary table for the data

```{r}
summary(penguins)
```

## A plot to show off some features

```{r}
ggplot(
  data = penguins,
  mapping = aes(x = bill_length_mm,
                y = species)
  )+ 
  geom_boxplot()
```
